name: GPT code reviewer
description: Submits code to an OpenAI-backed API and stores the returned review as a Review entity shown via Views.
project_description:
The GPT Code Reviewer module revolutionizes code quality and efficiency on Drupal platforms by leveraging OpenAI's cutting-edge AI technology. Aimed at developers of all skill levels, this module automates code review processes, offering insightful feedback, security vulnerability detection, and coding standards compliance. It's the perfect tool for teams seeking to enhance their code quality without the overhead of manual reviews.

 Features 
 GPT Code Reviewer offers an unparalleled suite of features to elevate Drupal development:

 
 Automated code reviews powered by OpenAI's API, providing real-time feedback and suggestions. 
 Detection of security vulnerabilities and code smells to enhance site safety and reliability. 
 Compliance checks against Drupal coding standards for consistency and best practices. 
 Customizable review settings to target specific project needs. 
 
 This module is essential for developers looking to streamline their workflow and ensure high-quality code production.

 Post-Installation 
 Upon installing GPT Code Reviewer, start a docker container of a GPT API Server which is responsible to connect with OpenAI API. Then navigate to the module’s configuration section to config your OpenAI API key and URL of the GPT API Server.

 Additional Requirements 
 To use GPT Code Reviewer, an active OpenAI API key is required. Ensure your Drupal installation meets the latest security and performance standards to maximize the module's effectiven
